title: 第25章 金属操控者第26章 永昼
slug: 末世我的女人有亿点强
lines: “你别废话，听老大的就对了。”刘宇几人对林羽是百分百的信任。
“给我打断他们的腿！”
随着王浩一声大喝，他身後的小弟们拎着武器就冲了过去。
林羽冲入人群。
一脚踹出，那人直接如同炮弹般飞了出去，连续砸翻了七八人後，倒在地上没了呼吸。
钢管重重砸在林羽肩膀上，他却像没事人一样，一拳砸在那人胸口。
鲜血喷出，那人直挺挺的倒地，他的胸口已经凹陷了下去。
林羽如同猛虎下山，狼入羊群。
每一招，都能带走一个小卡拉米。
在场的人全都倒吸一口凉气。
这是什麽牛马怪物？
“这个人怕不是已经10级了吧？”王浩看着勇猛如怪兽的林羽，心中骇然。
“或者就是吃过不少力量果实。”
“那就按照老规矩，一会儿我撤掉禁魔，你立刻用天赋袭杀他。”
胡斌应了一声，暗中缓缓积蓄力量。
他们没想到，禁魔的情况下，六七十个手下，连那个人都打不过。
恐怕再过七八分钟，他的小弟们都死光了。
“就是现在！”
王浩眼神一凝，瞬间撤掉了禁魔。
胡斌也是刹那间出手。
无数的钢筋快如闪电，眨眼之间便到了林羽身前。
这样的操作，他们两人配合了无数次，早就能做到天衣无缝，完美衔接了。
却不想，林羽早有预料。
“火焰咆哮！”
就在禁魔消失的瞬间，他同样施展出了自己的天赋异能。
火焰从他口中喷射而出，携带着无匹的力量，将飞来的钢管，还有周围的人冲击了倒飞回去。
火焰燃烧，那些人落地的时候，没挣扎几下就去见了阎王。
“这不可能！”王浩瞪大眼睛。
林羽身形晃动，扑向两人。
他的速度极快，瞬息便到。拳头上火焰包裹，直接砸了过去。
“禁魔！”
无赖技能再度发动，林羽拳头上的火焰凭空消失，但他的拳头还是直击向前。
“去死吧！”
王浩手中出现一把匕首，同样刺向林羽。
他觉醒s级天赋的时候，全属性可是增加了20点，後面又吸收了几个属性果实，他不相信林羽力量会比他还强。
content_en:
"Don't talk nonsense, just listen to the boss." Liu Yu and the others had 100% trust in Lin Yu.
"Break their legs!"
As Wang Hao shouted, the boys behind him rushed over with weapons in hand.
Lin Yu rushed into the crowd.
With one kick, the man flew out like a cannonball. After knocking over seven or eight people in a row, he fell to the ground without breathing.
"Bang!"
The steel pipe hit Lin Yu heavily on the shoulder, but he punched the man in the chest as if nothing was wrong.
Blood spurted out, and the man fell straight to the ground, his chest already dented.
Lin Yu was like a tiger descending from a mountain or a wolf entering a flock of sheep.
Every move can take away a little Karami.
"Hiss!"
Everyone present took a breath.
What kind of cow-horse monster is this?
"Isn't this person already at level 10?" Wang Hao looked at Lin Yu, who was as brave as a monster, and felt horrified.
"Or maybe I've eaten a lot of power fruits."
"Then follow the old rules. I will remove the forbidden demon in a moment, and you immediately use your talent to kill him."
"Yeah."
Hu Bin responded, slowly gathering strength secretly.
They didn't expect that under the ban on demons, six or seventy of their subordinates wouldn't even be able to defeat that person.
I'm afraid that in seven or eight minutes, all his brothers will be dead.
"Now!"
Wang Hao's eyes narrowed and he instantly removed the forbidden demon.
Hu Bin also took action instantly.
Countless steel bars were as fast as lightning, and arrived in front of Lin Yu in the blink of an eye.
The two of them have cooperated with this operation countless times, and they have long been able to achieve a seamless and perfect connection.
But unexpectedly, Lin Yu had expected it.
"Fire Roar!"
The moment the Forbidden Demon disappeared, he also displayed his innate abilities.
Flames spurted out from his mouth, carrying unparalleled power, knocking back the flying steel pipes and the people around him.
The flames burned, and when those people landed, they went to see the King of Hell without struggling a few times.
"This is impossible!" Wang Hao's eyes widened.
Lin Yu swayed and pounced on the two of them.
His speed is extremely fast and he is there in an instant. His fist was wrapped in flames and he smashed it directly.
"Forbidden Demon!"
The rogue skill was activated again, and the flames on Lin Yu's fist disappeared out of thin air, but his fist still struck forward.
"Go to hell!"
A dagger appeared in Wang Hao's hand and stabbed Lin Yu as well.
When he awakened his S-level talent, all attributes increased by 20 points, and he later absorbed several attribute fruits. He did not believe that Lin Yu would be stronger than him.
